ForgeMCP Encyclopedia

This index catalogs evidence found in [local path]. Previously relocated reports and JSON retain their original bytes. This log batch archives historical ForgeMCP-related .log files under 11_Logs_and_Diagnostics, preserving each source-relative path and recording SHA-256 receipts. The live production Editor log remains at its source path while PID 33500 is running. Project assets, checkpoints, and unrelated evidence remain in place.

  • Initial evidence catalog scan: 52,473 files; 14,420 evidence entries.
  • Previously relocated reports and JSON: 2,589 files (2,565 Markdown, 24 JSON); 24,755,730 bytes.
  • Historical ForgeMCP-related logs moved in this batch: 1,711 files; 49,361,276 bytes.
  • Log moves independently SHA-256 verified: 1,711; failures: 0.
  • Active production Editor log left in place: Saved/Logs/ForgeMCPDev.log.
  • Byte-identical pairs among relocated reports: 0. One active log remains outside the archive and was not moved.

Current authoritative terrain boundary

The latest October 24 terrain acceptance audit records the basin, offset lobe, and west hill saved in two scoped packages, with live ForgeTerrain MD5 a67ab415e4c454826b8a971280b2da0e and Original Layer MD5 9f43572fbc2c06ef497da015879cdb23. Live collision traces passed, but independent disk reload and close-up visual acceptance remain blocked. The west-hill job retains its historical validation_failed_partial result; the east hill was not applied. Earlier Stage 2E and multi-sculpt reports describe earlier baselines and do not supersede this audit.
